I've finished reviewing the three finalists for the marketing coordinator position. Their reference checks came back clean, but candidate B has a stronger portfolio of campaign metrics. Let me know if you want to schedule final interviews this week or wait until the Q2 budget numbers are confirmed.

Just reviewed the Q3 travel budget and we're tracking 12% over due to last-minute flight changes. I'm pulling together a consolidated report with cost-per-trip breakdowns and vendor comparison options to present at Friday's meeting. Let me know if anyone needs specific data points included before I finalize.

The main conference room HVAC unit has been making loud rattling noises since yesterday. I contacted the building maintenance team and they're scheduled to inspect it tomorrow morning at 9am. I'll follow up after the visit to confirm the repair timeline.

Sent the job posting for the junior analyst role to HR for review. Should be live on our careers page by Wednesday if there are no issues. Let me know if anyone wants changes to the requirements or compensation range before it goes public.

Reviewing the Smithson contract amendments today. The liability cap language in section 8.3 still needs clarification—current drafting leaves us exposed on consequential damages. I'll redraft and circulate by 3pm for team review.

The conference room projector has been flickering during presentations all week. I'll contact IT today to schedule a repair or replacement, but we should have a backup plan for Thursday's client meeting if it isn't fixed by then. Does anyone have a portable projector we could reserve, or should I look into renting one?

One is a login issue affecting the regional sales team's CRM access, and the other involves a data sync failure between our inventory system and the vendor portal. I'm escalating both to Tier 2 and will post updates as they progress.
